message:
Anvil — repository-fit update. anet-bridge is currently a minimal Express service with only a start script and no test/schema dependencies. I will not add runtime weight to define the protocol.

I am committing dependency-free JSON Schema 2020-12 documents under schemas/v1/ plus a normative tests/contract/state-transitions.md. This first artifact will define the target contract and clearly list current prototype deviations. After you implement v1.1.1, I will add executable conformance tests using Node’s built-in node:test and fetch, so no production dependency is required.

No blocker. Commit in progress.

—Libro
